title: French numbers, days & dates
examples: How do I say the number seventy-five in French?
What is the French word for Tuesday?
Can you teach me how to say a full date in French?

explain.say: Today we are learning French numbers up to one hundred.
Let us practice some numbers like twenty-one and thirty-three.
Next we learn the names for the days of the week in French.
The months in French are quite useful for talking about dates.
Putting it together, a full date uses the day and the month.
For a real-life example, if your birthday is the fifteenth of March.

faq.q: How do I say seventy-five in French?
faq.a: You say soixante-quinze. It comes from sixty and then fifteen.

faq.q: Do the days of the week change in French?
faq.a: No, the days of the week are the same in structure. You just learn the French names.
asks: How do you say Thursday in French?

faq.q: Is there a special word for the date?
faq.a: Yes, you often use the word 'le' before the day when stating the date.
asks: How do I start a date in French?
What word comes before the day?

faq.q: Do I need to learn all the numbers up to one hundred?
faq.a: Learning the main patterns helps a lot. Focus on the teens and the multiples of ten first.
asks: What is the hardest number range?
Do I need to memorize all numbers?

faq.q: What is the difference between a month and a day?
faq.a: A day is one of the seven days. A month is a longer period containing many days.
asks: How many days are in a month?

facts: The number sixty is said as soixante.
The number seventy is said as soixante-dix.
The month for January is janvier.

quiz.say: What is the French word for Wednesday?
quiz.why: Mercredi is the correct word for Wednesday in French.

wrong.0: Lundi is the first day, Monday, not Wednesday.
wrong.2: Mardi means Tuesday, which is close but incorrect.
wrong.3: Jeudi means Thursday, so it is one day too late.

quiz.say: How do you write the date for the tenth of May?
quiz.why: When stating a date, you usually use the article 'le' before the day.

wrong.0: The order is day then month, not month then day.
wrong.1: We do not use a hyphen when writing the date this way.
wrong.3: You need the article 'le' to make it sound like a full date.

quiz.say: What is the correct French word for the number eighty?
quiz.why: The number eighty is formed by four times twenty, which is quatre-vingts.

wrong.0: This combination means ninety, not eighty.
wrong.2: This is not the correct spelling pattern for eighty.
wrong.3: You must add an 's' to 'vingt' when it stands alone for eighty.
